privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Marg Darshan collects, uses and protects your personal data, in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.intro: Marg Darshan (“we”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you use our website and services, why we collect it, and what rights you have. It is written in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).

items.i1: Contact details: name, email, WhatsApp number.
items.i2: Birth details: date, time and place of birth (including latitude, longitude and time zone), gender.
items.i3: Consultation details: your question, property address and floor plan for Vastu, and life events for birth-time rectification.
items.i4: Payment records: order and transaction IDs. Card and UPI details are handled by Razorpay and never reach us.
items.i5: Technical data: IP address, browser type and language preference (for security and abuse prevention).

use.title: How we use it
use.body: We use your information only for these purposes, each based on your consent or another lawful ground:

items.i1: Preparing your Kundali and your consultation.
items.i3: Sending the weekly newsletter, if you have opted in.
items.i4: Meeting legal, tax and accounting obligations.

use.note: We never sell your data and never share it with third parties for advertising.

share.title: Service providers (data processors)
share.body: To deliver our services we rely on a few trusted providers, who process data only on our instructions and under contract:

items.i2: Email service provider — confirmations and newsletter.
items.i3: Calendar and Zoom — appointments and video consultations.
items.i4: Cloud hosting and storage — website, database and uploaded floor plans.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: Consultation and Kundali data is kept while you use our services or until you ask us to delete it. Payment records are kept for the period tax laws require. Data is erased once its purpose is fulfilled.

rights.title: Your rights (DPDP Act, 2023)

items.i1: Obtain a summary of your personal data and how it is processed.
items.i2: Correct and update inaccurate or incomplete data.
items.i4: Withdraw consent at any time — for example, unsubscribe from the newsletter.
items.i5: Grievance redressal, and nominate someone to exercise your rights on your behalf.

rights.note: To make a request, write to {email}. We will respond within the prescribed time.

security.title: Security
security.body: Data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS), access is limited to authorised staff, and payments run on PCI-DSS compliant Razorpay. No system on the internet is 100% secure; in case of a personal data breach we will notify you and the Data Protection Board as the law requires.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only essential cookies — for example to remember your language choice (NEXT_LOCALE). Half-filled forms are kept in your browser's sessionStorage and cleared when you close the tab.

children.title: Children's data
children.body: Kundalis or consultations for anyone under 18 should be booked only with the consent of a parent or guardian.

grievance.title: Grievance officer
grievance.body: For privacy complaints, write to our grievance officer at {email}. If you are not satisfied with the response, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: Any changes will be published on this page with a new date. Significant changes will also be emailed to you.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: Terms for using the Marg Darshan website, free Kundali, consultation bookings and shop enquiries.
terms.intro: By using the Marg Darshan website and services you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

nature.title: Nature of our services
nature.body: Astrology, Vastu and gemstone consultations are guidance based on traditional shastras. They do not guarantee any outcome and are not a substitute for professional medical, legal or financial advice. Always consult a qualified professional for health, legal or investment decisions.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be 18 or older to book services. Bookings for minors should be made by a parent or guardian.

items.i1: When you choose a slot it is held for you for {holdMinutes} minutes; if payment is not completed in that time, the slot is released automatically.
items.i2: A booking is confirmed only after our server verifies the payment.
items.i3: Providing accurate birth details is your responsibility; incorrect details can affect the analysis.
items.i4: The Zoom link for an online session is for the person who booked it.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: All fees are in Indian rupees (INR) and collected through Razorpay. Under the Split Plan, the advance confirms the slot and the balance is due before the report or site visit. Cancellations and refunds follow our refund policy.

conduct.title: Your conduct
conduct.body: Please ask before recording a session. Misuse of the website or its APIs, automated scraping, or using someone else's data is prohibited.

kundali.title: Free Kundali
kundali.body: The free Kundali is an automated calculation based on the details you provide. Use it for personal, non-commercial information.

shop.title: Shop (enquiry only)
shop.body: Nothing is sold online in the shop. When you send an enquiry we share availability, price and certification details on WhatsApp; any purchase is agreed separately.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: Website content, design and reports belong to Marg Darshan. Personal use is permitted; commercial use without written permission is not. The source code of the astrology calculation engine is available separately under the AGPL licence.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, Marg Darshan is not liable for the outcomes of decisions taken on the basis of any consultation. In any case, our liability will not exceed the amount paid for the service concerned.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute will first be addressed through good-faith discussion; thereafter the courts of the city of our office will have jurisdiction.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.metaDescription: Everything about cancelling or rescheduling Marg Darshan consultations, Split Plan advances and refunds.
refund.intro: We want your experience to be smooth. This policy explains when you can reschedule, when refunds apply and how long they take.

items.i1: {hours} hours or more before the session: reschedule once, completely free.
items.i2: Less than {hours} hours before the session: rescheduling and refunds are not possible.
items.i3: To reschedule, message us on WhatsApp or email with your booking ID.

items.i1: Cancelled {hours} hours or more before the session: full refund of the amount paid (less gateway charges, if any).
items.i2: Cancelled less than {hours} hours before: no refund.
items.i3: Not joining at the scheduled time (no-show): no refund.

ours.title: Cancellation by us
ours.body: If we ever have to cancel a session for unavoidable reasons, you can choose a new time or take a full refund — your choice.

items.i1: The {pct}% advance confirms the slot. The {hours}-hour rules above apply to the advance as well.
items.i2: A payment link for the balance is sent before the report or site visit; the report is delivered or the visit takes place after the balance is paid.
items.i3: Once a site visit has taken place, the advance is non-refundable.

failed.title: Failed or duplicate payments
failed.body: If money was debited but the booking was not confirmed, or you were charged twice by mistake, the extra amount is refunded in full — automatically or on request.

timeline.title: How and when refunds arrive
timeline.body: Approved refunds are returned through Razorpay to the original payment method (UPI, card or net banking). Depending on your bank, the amount appears within 5–7 working days.

free.title: Free services and the shop
free.body: The free Kundali costs nothing, so refunds do not apply. The shop is enquiry-only — no payments are taken on the website.

contact.title: Requesting a refund
contact.body: Write to {email} or message us on WhatsApp with your booking ID. We reply within 2 working days.
